{{Quote|We were traveling from Circarpous X to Four on business.''"<br />"''You were coming from the Rebel base on Fourteen, you mean. So much for trust.|Luke Skywalker and Halla|<ref name="SotME" />}}
A '''rebel base''' was established on [[Circarpous XIV]] in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Halla]] knew of this base, but saw no reason to betray its location to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
